definitions.explanation: The underground part of a plant that absorbs water and nutrients. Slightly informal/colloquial.

examples.english: The roots of the tree are sticking out of the ground.

examples.japanese: {根|ね}っこ⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{引|ひ}き{抜|ぬ}いた→引き抜く：17604_hikinuku⟧。
examples.english: I pulled it out from the root.

examples.japanese: ⟦{雑草|ざっそう}→雑草：04996_zassou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{根|ね}っこ⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{取|と}る→取る：00565_toru⟧。
examples.english: I remove the roots of the weeds.

examples.japanese: ⟦{台風|たいふう}→台風：01455_taifuu⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{大|おお}きな→大きな：02849_ookina⟧⟦{木|き}→木：00524_ki⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{根|ね}っこ⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{倒|たお}れた→倒れる：01160_taoreru⟧。
examples.english: A large tree fell from its roots in the typhoon.

examples.japanese: ⟦{古|ふる}い→古い：00488_furui⟧⟦{木|き}→木：00524_ki⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{根|ね}っこ⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{地面|じめん}→地面：00125_jimen⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{下|した}→下：00670_shita⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{深|ふか}く→深い：01211_fukai⟧⟦{広|ひろ}がっていて→広がる：01980_hirogaru⟧、⟦なかなか→なかなか：01547_nakanaka⟧⟦{抜|ぬ}けない→抜ける：02385_nukeru⟧。
examples.english: The roots of old trees spread deep underground and are hard to pull out.

notes:
{根|ね}っこ is a colloquial term for the root of a plant.

FORMS:
⟦{根|ね}→根：03525_ne⟧ (root) + っこ (diminutive/casual suffix)

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- {根|ね}っこ⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{引|ひ}き{抜|ぬ}く→引き抜く：17604_hikinuku⟧: to pull out from the root
- {根|ね}っこ⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{取|と}る→取る：00565_toru⟧: to remove the roots
- ⟦{木|き}→木：00524_ki⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{根|ね}っこ: tree roots

REGISTER:
Slightly informal/colloquial. Use ⟦{根|ね}→根：03525_ne⟧ in more formal contexts.

RELATED WORDS:
- ⟦{根|ね}→根：03525_ne⟧: root (standard)
- ⟦{根元|ねもと}→根元：13114_nemoto⟧: base, root area
- ⟦{根|ね}→根：03525_ne⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{張|は}る→張る：12583_haru⟧: to take root (figurative)

USAGE:
Can imply the fundamental/deep-rooted part: ⟦{問題|もんだい}→問題：00797_mondai⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{根|ね}っこ (the root of a problem).
